summary: Iteration-5 baseline investigation completed. Wrote 9 durable pytest regressions covering tampered/spoofed referral cookies (D2C only), FIRST-policy A->B preservation with direct persisted-field assertions on reseller_id, repeat_attribution=false exclusion (customer_key/attribution_exclusion/commission_exclusion + no ledger row), same-normalized-mobile self-referral (email differs), missing-cost profit=null historical immutability, two-line other_cost_per_order=0.01 paise reconciliation with product-level allocation summing exactly to totals, and admin manage-order + payout-review backend validation gates including reason/reference/notes minlengths, PAID checkbox requirement, future-date block, and PAID immutability. All 9 tests passed against production URL. Frontend spot-check: home, shop, admin login, and Orders MANAGE modal all render with expected testids and interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Field component does not forward `minLength` prop to textarea (only to <input>). Reason and payout notes textareas therefore have no browser-side minlength=4 enforcement; users can submit short strings that are rejected only after a network 422. Backend validation is correct, so this is a UI-only ergonomics/consistency defect (matches the report_any_reproducible_defect hint in the request).

action_items: Forward minLength to <textarea> in portal/UI.jsx Field (parity with <input>) so admin reason/notes get client-side gating; backend already enforces.

Optional: /api/admin/business/orders response could surface attribution_exclusion in order_summary (currently public list only exposes commission_exclusion). Tests had to read directly from Mongo to assert attribution_exclusion=REPEAT_ORDER_DISABLED / SELF_REFERRAL.
Main agent may clean up QA_ITER4 + QA_ITER5 orders/commissions/payouts/adjustments/sessions using manifests when confident tests will not be re-run.

No admin payout modal UI could be reviewed via Playwright because every existing payout row is already in a terminal state (PAID/FAILED). Backend validation for that modal was fully exercised via API.
critical_code_review_comments: Referral security is robust: current_referral() rejects tampered cookies via SHA-256 digest lookup; Input pydantic model uses extra='forbid' so body-spoofed reseller_id/order_channel are rejected. Confirmed by black-box tests.

FIRST policy correctly branches in referrals.visit(): existing session is preserved when policy in ('FIRST','OWNERSHIP'), and order_context uses cookie session (immutable) rather than trusting the latest /visit call.

repeat_attribution=False is enforced in two places (referrals.order_context sets attribution_exclusion pre-persist; financial.synchronize_order sets commission_exclusion=REPEAT_ORDER_DISABLED for retroactive customer_ownership races). Both paths verified.

economics.snapshot() other_cost split uses proportional allocation with a last-part residual absorber (metrics.py line 59 uses round((other * part.sales) / max(sales,1))). For two equally priced parts with other_cost_minor=1 paise, this rounds each to 1 paise -> product-level total may over-attribute 1 paise vs order snapshot. In test run this did not surface because current historical products lacked configured rules (commission=None => products.profit_minor stayed null). Recommend adding a residual absorber in metrics.py aggregation loop (mirror the pattern used for commission) to guarantee product-level sums reconcile exactly to snapshot totals when profit is knowable.
financial.update_payout enforces every requested guard: >=4 char notes, >=3 char reference, non-future payment_date, actual_payment_confirmed, and hard-locks transitions from PAID/FAILED.
Field component in portal/UI.jsx omits minLength on textarea path -- inconsistent with input path (minor UI gap).

success_rate.frontend: spot-check only: home/shop/cart drawer/admin login/orders-MANAGE modal verified; payout-review modal not exercisable via UI because no non-terminal rows exist

test_credentials: Admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; resellers A/B from /app/test_reports/portal_iter3_credentials.json (both APPROVED); B used for finance to avoid A's pre-existing unsettled adjustments.
seed_data_creation: Created QA_ITER5 orders (referral+D2C+self), commissions, one payable-then-PAID payout on reseller B, a rule-free multi-line paid order, and a temporary business_settings mutation (product_costs + other_cost_per_order=0.01) which was restored in test teardown. Manifest at /app/test_reports/qa_iter5_manifest.json for main-agent cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter5 regression file passes cleanly. To probe payout UI modal via Playwright, seed at least one PENDING/APPROVED payout on reseller B first (existing rows are all PAID/FAILED). Field-textarea minLength gap is a known low-priority UI defect. When testing repeat_attribution + self-referral scenarios, use direct Mongo reads for attribution_exclusion/customer_key since /api/admin/business/orders does not surface them.
rca of the issue: No reproducible product defect surfaced against the requested behavior contracts. Only a minor UI validation gap (Field->textarea minLength not forwarded) reproduces; backend validators independently reject short input, so functional integrity is unaffected. All referral security, repeat-attribution, self-referral, historical snapshot immutability, and payout-review guards behave as specified in the request.
